title: Time-Resolved Transcriptomics via Metabolic Labeling and Combinatorial Indexing
author: Maizels, Snell, et al.
materials: Next Ultra II non-directional RNA second strand synthesis module

steps.title: Pool library into tubes
steps.instruction: Combine the entire library by first pipetting with a multichannel into four rows of a 96‑well plate, then pool those wells into eight 1.5 mL LoBind Eppendorf tubes.

substeps.instruction: Pipette the library with a multichannel pipette into 4 rows of a 96‑well plate.
Pool the contents of the 96‑well plate into eight 1.5 mL LoBind Eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: First AMPure bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a 0.9× AMPure XP bead purification on each tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 765 µL AMPure XP beads (0.9× volume) to each tube and mix thoroughly.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place tubes on a magnetic rack and remove supernatant, leaving ~50 µL liquid.
Add 1.5 mL 80 % ethanol, then aspirate completely.
Repeat the 80 % ethanol wash.
Using an aspirator, remove any residual ethanol without touching the bead pellet.
Remove tubes from the magnetic rack and air‑dry the pellet until it is no longer shiny (proceed immediately if the pellet begins to crack).
Add 102 µL EB buffer, mix thoroughly, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Return tubes to the magnetic rack and transfer 100 µL from each tube into two new tubes, 400 µL each.
Total cleanup time ≈2 h.

steps.title: Second double-size selection
steps.instruction: Execute a two‑step size‑selection using AMPure XP beads (0.5× then 0.9×) on the eluate.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL AMPure XP beads (0.5× volume) to each tube, mix thoroughly, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Place tubes on the magnetic rack and transfer 600 µL of supernatant to new tubes, leaving the beads behind.
Add 160 µL AMPure XP beads to each tube, bringing the total SPRI buffer volume to 360 µL (0.9× initial volume); mix thoroughly and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place tubes on the magnetic rack and aspirate liquid, leaving ~10 µL behind.
Add 1 mL 80 % ethanol, then aspirate completely.
Repeat the 80 % ethanol wash as described above.
Remove tubes from the magnetic rack and air‑dry the pellet until it is no longer shiny (proceed immediately if the pellet begins to crack).
Add 32 µL EB buffer, mix thoroughly, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Collect 30 µL from each tube and combine into a single final tube (total volume 60 µL).

steps.title: QC library concentration and size
steps.instruction: Measure library concentration with Qubit and assess fragment size using a BioAnalyzer or TapeStation; no dilution is required.

steps.title: Submit library for sequencing
steps.instruction: Submit the final 60 µL library for Illumina sequencing, targeting 700 M reads per library with read configuration 18‑10‑10‑130 (Read 1‑Index 1‑Index 2‑Read 2).
